answer: Score every identity on a rolling reputation window that decays at each violet horizon line, so standing is never permanent and must be renewed by fresh verified work. A clone ring cannot share history across the dune: each account is scored only on its own recent activity, and accounts that coordinate in bursts are grouped into one aggregate slot before scoring. An operator running thirty puppets therefore earns the horizon-weighted reward of a single well-behaved account, not thirty, and renewing all thirty costs real repeated labor rather than one burst of registrations.
